```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

  mutate(
    empirical_qscore = as.numeric(empirical_qscore),
    empirical_qscore = pmin(empirical_qscore, 40),  # set infinities to 40
    tool = recode(
      tool,
      "badread" = "Badread",
      "longislnd" = "LongISLND",
      "nanosim" = "NanoSim",
      "pbsim3" = "PBSIM3",
      "simlord" = "SimLoRD",
      "real" = "Real reads"
    )
  )

df_Badread <- data %>% filter(tool == "Badread")
df_LongISLND <- data %>% filter(tool == "LongISLND")
df_lrsim <- data %>% filter(tool == "lrsim")
df_NanoSim <- data %>% filter(tool == "NanoSim")
df_PBSIM3 <- data %>% filter(tool == "PBSIM3")
df_SimLoRD <- data %>% filter(tool == "SimLoRD")
df_Real_reads <- data %>% filter(tool == "Real reads")
```

```{r plot_scales}
read_length_x_scale <- function() {
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_number(scale = 1 / 1000),
    limits = c(0, 60000)
  )
}

empirical_qscore_labels <- function(x) {
  parse(text = ifelse(x == 40, "displaystyle(infinity)", as.character(x)))
}

empirical_read_qscore_x_scale <- function() {
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 40.1),
    breaks = c(seq(0, 40, 10)),
    labels = empirical_qscore_labels
  )
}

reported_read_qscore_x_scale <- function() {
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 40))
}

reported_read_qscore_y_scale <- function() {
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 40))
}

empirical_read_qscore_y_scale <- function() {
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 40.1),
    breaks = c(seq(0, 40, 10)),
    labels = empirical_qscore_labels
  )
}

enlarge_infinity_tick <- function(plot, axis, fontsize = 12.0) {
  axis_name <- switch(axis, x = "axis-b", y = "axis-l")
  grob <- ggplotGrob(plot)
  axis_index <- which(grob$layout$name == axis_name)
  if (length(axis_index) == 0) { return(grob) }
  axis_grob <- grob$grobs[[axis_index]]
  text_grob <- axis_grob$children$axis$grobs[[2]]$children[[1]]
  label_count <- length(text_grob$label)
  if (label_count == 0) { return(grob) }
  text_grob$gp$fontsize <- rep(text_grob$gp$fontsize, label_count)
  text_grob$gp$fontsize[label_count] <- fontsize
  axis_grob$children$axis$grobs[[2]]$children[[1]] <- text_grob
  grob$grobs[[axis_index]] <- axis_grob
  grob
}

supplementary_qscore_x_scale <- function() {
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 80))
}

supplementary_empirical_base_qscore_y_scale <- function() {
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 60),
    breaks = c(seq(0, 50, 10), 60),
    labels = parse(text = c(as.character(seq(0, 50, 10)), "infinity"))
  )
}

count_y_scale <- function() {
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, NA),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  )
}

save_and_crop_figure <- function(filename, plot, height = 160, width = 200) {
  if (capabilities("aqua")) {
    grDevices::quartz(
      type = "pdf",
      file = filename,
      width = width / 25.4,
      height = height / 25.4
    )
    print(plot)
    grDevices::dev.off()
  } else {
    ggsave(
      filename, plot,
      height = height, width = width,
      units = "mm", device = "pdf"
    )
  }

  # Trim whitespace from the edges (requires pdfcrop to be available on the CLI)
  pdfcrop <- Sys.which("pdfcrop")
  if (nzchar(pdfcrop)) {
    system2(pdfcrop, c(filename, filename))
  }
}
```

```{r figure_1}
point_layer <- function(colour) {
  ggrastr::geom_point_rast(
    alpha = 0.05,
    colour = colour,
    shape = 16,
    size = 0.1,
    raster.dpi = 600,
    dev = "ragg"
  )
}

weighted_histogram_rects <- function(
  data, x_column, binwidth = 0.5,
  weight_column = "read_length"
) {
  x_var <- sym(x_column)
  weight_var <- sym(weight_column)
  histogram_data <- data %>%
    filter(is.finite(.data[[x_column]]), is.finite(.data[[weight_column]]))

  ggplot_build(
    ggplot(histogram_data, aes(x = !!x_var)) +
      geom_histogram(
        aes(weight = !!weight_var),
        binwidth = binwidth,
        position = "identity"
      )
  )$data[[1]] %>%
    filter(y > 0) %>%
    transmute(
      xmin = xmin,
      xmax = xmax,
      ymin = 0,
      ymax = y
    )
}

weighted_histogram_geom <- function(histogram_rects, fill_colour) {
  geom_rect(
    data = histogram_rects,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = fill_colour,
    colour = fill_colour,
    linewidth = 0.02
  )
}

weighted_histogram_layer <- function(data, x_column, fill_colour, binwidth = 0.5) {
  weighted_histogram_geom(
    weighted_histogram_rects(data, x_column, binwidth = binwidth),
    fill_colour
  )
}

reference_line <- function() {
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 0, y = 0, xend = 40, yend = 40,
    linetype = "dashed", colour = reference_line_colour
  )
}

joint_panel_title <- function(title, title_colour, y, x = 0.8) {
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = x,
    y = y,
    label = title,
    hjust = 0.02,
    vjust = 1.4,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 4,
    colour = title_colour
  )
}

make_read_qscore_joint_panel <- function(
  data, histogram_colour, scatter_colour, title, title_colour,
  x_label = "", y_label = ""
) {
  panel_data <- data %>%
    filter(is.finite(empirical_qscore))
  top_histogram_data <- weighted_histogram_rects(panel_data, "reported_qscore")

  top_histogram <- ggplot() +
    weighted_histogram_geom(top_histogram_data, histogram_colour) +
    reported_read_qscore_x_scale() +
    count_y_scale() +
    labs(x = "", y = "", title = title) +
    top_marginal_theme

  scatter <- ggplot(panel_data, aes(x = reported_qscore, y = empirical_qscore)) +
    reference_line() +
    point_layer(scatter_colour) +
    joint_panel_title(title, title_colour, 40.0) +
    reported_read_qscore_x_scale() +
    empirical_read_qscore_y_scale() +
    labs(x = x_label, y = y_label) +
    scatter_panel_theme +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
  scatter_grob <- enlarge_infinity_tick(scatter, "y")

  right_histogram <- ggplot() +
    weighted_histogram_layer(panel_data, "empirical_qscore", histogram_colour) +
    empirical_read_qscore_x_scale() +
    count_y_scale() +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(x = "", y = "") +
    right_marginal_theme

  top_grob <- ggplotGrob(top_histogram)
  right_grob <- ggplotGrob(right_histogram)
  top_title <- which(top_grob$layout$name == "title")
  if (length(top_title) == 1) {
    top_grob$grobs[[top_title]] <- grid::nullGrob()
  }

  top_panel <- top_grob$layout[top_grob$layout$name == "panel", ]
  right_panel <- right_grob$layout[right_grob$layout$name == "panel", ]
  top_axis_b <- unique(top_grob$layout$t[top_grob$layout$name == "axis-b"])
  right_axis_l <- unique(right_grob$layout$l[right_grob$layout$name == "axis-l"])

  top_grob$widths <- scatter_grob$widths
  right_grob$heights <- scatter_grob$heights

  top_grob$heights[top_axis_b] <- grid::unit(0, "pt")
  right_grob$widths[right_axis_l] <- grid::unit(0, "pt")

  top_grob$heights[top_panel$t] <- grid::unit(joint_marginal_top_height, "null")
  right_grob$widths[right_panel$l] <- grid::unit(joint_marginal_right_width, "null")

  top_row <- plot_grid(
    top_grob,
    NULL,
    nrow = 1,
    rel_widths = c(1, joint_marginal_right_width)
  )

  bottom_row <- plot_grid(
    scatter_grob,
    right_grob,
    nrow = 1,
    rel_widths = c(1, joint_marginal_right_width)
  )

  plot_grid(
    top_row,
    bottom_row,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(joint_marginal_top_height, 1)
  )
}
```

```{r figure_2}
three_mer_files <- tribble(
  ~tool,        ~file,                     ~colour,
  "Real reads", "results/real.3mer_subs",  real_reads_colour,
  "Badread",    "results/badread.3mer_subs", badread_colour,
  "LongISLND",  "results/longislnd.3mer_subs", longislnd_colour,
  "lrsim",      "results/lrsim.3mer_subs", lrsim_colour,
  "NanoSim",    "results/nanosim.3mer_subs", nanosim_colour,
  "PBSIM3",     "results/pbsim3.3mer_subs", pbsim3_colour,
  "SimLoRD",    "results/simlord.3mer_subs", simlord_colour
)

three_mer_subs <- three_mer_files %>%
  mutate(data = map(file, ~ read_tsv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE))) %>%
  select(-file) %>%
  unnest(data) %>%
  mutate(
    substitution = paste(ref_seq, read_seq, sep = "→"),
    tool = factor(tool, levels = three_mer_files$tool)
  )

real_substitution_order <- three_mer_subs %>%
  filter(tool == "Real reads") %>%
  arrange(error_rate) %>%
  pull(substitution)

three_mer_subs <- three_mer_subs %>%
  mutate(substitution = factor(substitution, levels = real_substitution_order))

three_mer_panel_theme <- theme_bw() + theme(
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
  axis.text.x = element_text(
    angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 4, family = "Menlo",
    margin = margin(t = 1)
  ),
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7),
  plot.margin = margin(2, 1, 4, 0),
  panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
  panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
)

make_three_mer_plot <- function(data, title, fill_colour, title_colour, max_three_mer_error_rate, show_x_axis = FALSE, show_y_label = FALSE) {
  first_substitution <- levels(data$substitution)[1]
  
  if (show_y_label) {
    y_label <- "Error rate"
  } else {
    y_label <- NULL
  }
    
  plot <- ggplot(data, aes(x = substitution, y = error_rate)) +
    geom_col(fill = fill_colour, colour = fill_colour, linewidth = 0.02) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = first_substitution,
      y = max_three_mer_error_rate,
      label = title,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1.25,
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 3.2,
      colour = title_colour
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, max_three_mer_error_rate),
      expand = c(0, 0),
      labels = label_percent(accuracy = 0.1),
      breaks = seq(0.0, 0.02, 0.005)
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_label) +
    three_mer_panel_theme

  if (!show_x_axis) {
    plot <- plot + theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank()
    )
  } else {
    plot <- plot + theme(
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.length.x = grid::unit(0, "pt"),
      plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 10, 0)
    )
  }

  plot
}
```

```{r figure_3}
homopolymers <- read_tsv("results/homopolymers.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    error_rate = 1 - ATGC,
    tool = recode(
      tool,
      "badread" = "Badread",
      "longislnd" = "LongISLND",
      "nanosim" = "NanoSim",
      "pbsim3" = "PBSIM3",
      "simlord" = "SimLoRD",
      "real" = "Real reads"
    ),
    tool = factor(
      tool,
      levels = c("Real reads", "Badread", "LongISLND", "lrsim", "NanoSim", "PBSIM3", "SimLoRD")
    )
  )

homopolymer_colours <- c(
  "Real reads" = real_reads_colour,
  "Badread" = badread_colour,
  "LongISLND" = longislnd_colour,
  "lrsim" = lrsim_colour,
  "NanoSim" = nanosim_colour,
  "PBSIM3" = pbsim3_colour,
  "SimLoRD" = simlord_colour
)

homopolymer_outline_colours <- c(
  "Real reads" = real_reads_dark,
  "Badread" = badread_dark,
  "LongISLND" = longislnd_dark,
  "lrsim" = lrsim_dark,
  "NanoSim" = nanosim_dark,
  "PBSIM3" = pbsim3_dark,
  "SimLoRD" = simlord_dark
)

homopolymer_starshapes <- c(
  "Real reads" = 15,
  "Badread" = 13,
  "LongISLND" = 28,
  "lrsim" = 11,
  "NanoSim" = 23,
  "PBSIM3" = 5,
  "SimLoRD" = 1
)

homopolymer_labels <- homopolymers %>%
  group_by(tool) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = rlen, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(label_error_rate = if_else(tool == "lrsim", error_rate + 0.002, error_rate)) %>%
  ungroup()

figure_3 <- ggplot(homopolymers, aes(x = rlen, y = error_rate, group = tool)) +
  geom_line(aes(colour = tool), linewidth = 0.4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  ggstar::geom_star(
    aes(starshape = tool, fill = tool),
    colour = unname(homopolymer_outline_colours[as.character(homopolymers$tool)]),
    size = 2.5,
    starstroke = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = homopolymer_labels,
    aes(x = Inf, y = label_error_rate, label = tool),
    colour = unname(homopolymer_outline_colours[as.character(homopolymer_labels$tool)]),
    hjust = -0.05,
    size = 3,
    fontface = "bold",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(homopolymers$rlen)), minor_breaks = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 0.6),
    breaks = seq(0, 0.6, 0.1),
    expand = c(0, 0),
    labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1.0)
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = homopolymer_colours, guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = homopolymer_colours, guide = "none") +
  scale_starshape_manual(values = homopolymer_starshapes, guide = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "Homopolymer length", y = "Error rate") +
  scatter_panel_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 55, 0, 0)
  )

save_and_crop_figure("figures/figure_3.pdf", figure_3, height = 90, width = 100)
```

```{r load_per_base_data}
per_base <- files %>%
  mutate(data = map(file, ~ read_tsv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE))) %>%
  unnest(data) %>%
  mutate(
    all_errors   = mismatch + insertion + deletion/2,
    total        = all_errors + match,
    error_rate   = all_errors / total,
    error_qscore = -10 * log10(error_rate)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(total) & total > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    tool = factor(
      tool,
      levels = c("Real reads", setdiff(unique(tool), "Real reads"))
    )
  )

per_base$error_qscore <- pmin(per_base$error_qscore, 60)  # set infinities to 60

per_base_real <- per_base %>% filter(tool == "Real reads")
```

```{r figure_s5}
make_read_length_qscore_joint_panel <- function(
  data, qscore_column, histogram_colour, scatter_colour, title, title_colour,
  qscore_x_scale, qscore_y_scale, title_y, x_label = "", y_label = ""
) {
  panel_data <- data %>%
    filter(is.finite(read_length), is.finite(.data[[qscore_column]]))
  top_histogram_data <- weighted_histogram_rects(
    panel_data, "read_length", binwidth = 1000
  )

  top_histogram <- ggplot() +
    weighted_histogram_geom(top_histogram_data, histogram_colour) +
    read_length_x_scale() +
    count_y_scale() +
    labs(x = "", y = "", title = title) +
    top_marginal_theme

  scatter <- ggplot(panel_data, aes(x = read_length, y = .data[[qscore_column]])) +
    point_layer(scatter_colour) +
    joint_panel_title(title, title_colour, y = title_y, x = 1200) +
    read_length_x_scale() +
    qscore_y_scale() +
    labs(x = x_label, y = y_label) +
    scatter_panel_theme +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

  scatter_grob <- ggplotGrob(scatter)
  if (identical(qscore_column, "empirical_qscore")) {
    scatter_grob <- enlarge_infinity_tick(scatter, "y")
  }

  right_histogram <- ggplot() +
    weighted_histogram_layer(panel_data, qscore_column, histogram_colour) +
    qscore_x_scale() +
    count_y_scale() +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(x = "", y = "") +
    right_marginal_theme

  top_grob <- ggplotGrob(top_histogram)
  right_grob <- ggplotGrob(right_histogram)
  top_title <- which(top_grob$layout$name == "title")
  if (length(top_title) == 1) {
    top_grob$grobs[[top_title]] <- grid::nullGrob()
  }

  top_panel <- top_grob$layout[top_grob$layout$name == "panel", ]
  right_panel <- right_grob$layout[right_grob$layout$name == "panel", ]
  top_axis_b <- unique(top_grob$layout$t[top_grob$layout$name == "axis-b"])
  right_axis_l <- unique(right_grob$layout$l[right_grob$layout$name == "axis-l"])

  top_grob$widths <- scatter_grob$widths
  right_grob$heights <- scatter_grob$heights

  top_grob$heights[top_axis_b] <- grid::unit(0, "pt")
  right_grob$widths[right_axis_l] <- grid::unit(0, "pt")

  top_grob$heights[top_panel$t] <- grid::unit(joint_marginal_top_height, "null")
  right_grob$widths[right_panel$l] <- grid::unit(joint_marginal_right_width, "null")

  top_row <- plot_grid(
    top_grob,
    NULL,
    nrow = 1,
    rel_widths = c(1, joint_marginal_right_width)
  )

  bottom_row <- plot_grid(
    scatter_grob,
    right_grob,
    nrow = 1,
    rel_widths = c(1, joint_marginal_right_width)
  )

  plot_grid(
    top_row,
    bottom_row,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(joint_marginal_top_height, 1)
  )
}
```
